result.summary: Analysis reveals minor visual inconsistencies and redundant elements throughout the interface.

issues.description: Information hierarchy (delivery time and fee) is inconsistent between section carousels.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the placement and style of metadata for all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Delivery fee information is displayed twice on single restaurant listings, causing clutter.
issues.suggestion: Remove redundant text when a delivery badge is present on the image.

issues.description: Visual style is compromised by inconsistent placeholder illustrations instead of food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace varied vector art with high-quality, standardized product photography.
